text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:
- Swiss president Jean-Pascal Delamuraz arrived in China on Wednewday with a delegation of 30 top business representatives. This was the second stage of his Asian tour.
- Swissair will take over the freight activities of its Belgian partner airline Sabena.
- The Swiss Supream Court ruled that the Swiss government was wrong in its decision to forbid citizens from former Yogoslavja to buy arms unless they had a permanent residency permit.
- Opponents of a new labour law, which will includes liberalisation of Sunday and night shifts for woman, said compensation schemes were not sufficient.
